title: Sleek vase compatible with most small flowers
author: Sleazer
description:
Boost Me (for free)

If you want me to keep making these free designs, please consider boosting me. These models take a lot of time and modelling. Tyvm :)

Boost

Add a touch of style to your space with this compact, spiral mini vase. Perfectly sized for small flowers—fresh or dried—this vase makes a great accent piece for desks, shelves, or windowsills.

The elegant spiral design brings a modern, minimalist vibe, while its small footprint makes it ideal for tight spaces or grouped arrangements. Designed to print easily with no supports, it's beginner-friendly and quick to produce on most printers.

This model works great in PLA, PETG, or even silky filaments for a more decorative look. For holding fresh flowers, you can scale it slightly and seal the inside for a more watertight result.

**Features**

- Spiral design with an elegant twist
- Fits stems or bundles up to **50mm (1.97 inches)** wide
- Perfect for small flowers or clippings
- Fast print – no supports needed
- Great for PLA, PETG, or silky filaments
- Beautiful as a standalone piece or grouped set

**Printing Tips**

- Layer height: 0.2mm recommended
- Infill: 10–15% is plenty
- No supports required
- Optional: Scale up slightly and seal interior for water use
